findings.detail: The SV Newco 2 first lien loan should be one position; the value-only continuation row repeats the same cost and fair value and should not create a second duplicate key.

rationale: B02 flags two duplicate position keys for SV Newco 2, Inc. first lien senior secured loan. The raw schedule shows one substantive SV Newco 2 first lien loan row with principal, amortized cost, and fair value, immediately followed by a blank-company/value-only row repeating the same amortized cost and fair value. That source structure supports a duplicate/double-count extraction defect rather than two distinct positions.
